review_mode: focused narrative prior-art and six-workstream audit
rights_sources: NASA original catalog/repository/policy and distribution README; no archive download
eligibility: Primary methodological or empirical works directly addressing RUL Bayesian/uncertainty/conformal/interval evaluation or AR1 covariance; peer-reviewed prioritized, pertinent preprints labeled.
limits: No date restriction; English accessible sources; web discovery and primary publisher/author repositories, not subscribed exhaustive databases; no systematic-completeness or absent-prior-art certification.
source_inspection: Distinguish full text, abstract and metadata; source contents directly read, exact URLs and search records retained.
confidentiality: No protected outcomes, labels or per-engine payload in external searches or public files.
confidential_workstreams: Owner-only records retained; no public scientific findings included
